notes.title: VR ARCADE UPDATE: HTC RACKET COMPATIBLE + HOME RUN DERBY
notes.content: Hey all, we're releasing a new level for HOME RUN DERBY today and we think you're going to like it!  The game is also now compatible to work with the HTC RACKET and VIVE TRACKER so now you can swing more comfortably with 2 hands. We've created an entire new "bat mode" with auto pitching and re-loading tee stand. This is a perfect addition for sports fans and VR ARCADE owners.  Happy Swinging!

notes.title: MAJOR ART UPDATE + MORE !
notes.content: Hey PITCH-HITTERS we hope you had a good 4th of July!  And if you picked up PITCH-HIT during the summer sale, welcome to the fun!  We're happy to share our completely revamped levels with lots more art and smoother details with you guys!  But that's not all, we will be adding pitching mini games, and HOME RUN DERBY!!!  And look out for multiplayer!  Happy Swinging!

notes.title: BIG OCULUS TOUCH UPDATE!!
notes.content: We are happy to welcome all you TOUCH baseball players, we've incorporated the new OCULUS TOUCH system into our game, and we've even added a few buttons for folks that only have 2 sensors.  We know that turning around can be an issue sometimes, so we added a button that flips you around 180 degrees no matter what you are doing in game!  Makes choosing menus, catching baseballs, and hitting UFOs a lot easier.  We also added a few other cool things.  We re-did the ball trails for CATCH and DISTANCE, added better anti-aliasing, and tweaked a few things here and there.  We hope you enjoy, and happy swinging!
